name: Afternoon Delight
caption: A tag team that lost a tornado rules match to Van Wild and Scott Starring, then issued an open challenge for other tag teams to face them.

name: Real Xtreme
caption: Lance Williams and James Robinson, managed by Marty Lyons; became the promotion's own first Tag Team Champions by beating Werewolf Gregorson and Travis LaGrange at Initiation Rites, repeatedly leaning on Lyons's own ringside interference along the way.

name: Gangsta's Heaven
caption: A debuting tag team that attacked Afternoon Delight before its own first match, then lost in the tag title tournament's own quarterfinals.

identity.note: An exact-name collision (allowing for the apostrophe) against the held ipw-xfwl wing's own tag team Gangsta Heaven, whose members are also named Gotti and Hoffa. No document on either side names another federation, host, or shared performer; still a stronger-than-usual coincidence (matching team name and both individual names) worth a future review. Filed distinct pending evidence, per the collision doctrine.

name: South of the Border
caption: A tryout tag team that won its only recorded outing, over the Cum-Shot Feminists, by disqualification.

name: Cum-Shot Feminists
caption: A deliberately offensive gimmick team that debuted losing by disqualification, worked its way to a fresh number-one tag title contendership by winning a battle royal, and lost the title shot to a no-contest.

name: Hell's Angels
caption: The masked muscle of the Hatebreed, led to the ring on a leash by Cardinal Synn; won an Ultraviolent tag match by pure domination.

name: The Hatebreed
caption: Hell's Angels and "Son of Satan" Lucifer Magnusson, managed by Cardinal Synn; a recurring interference stable that repeatedly cost other wrestlers matches across the spring of 2004, including a triple powerbomb of Trevor Rodgers through a table.
